correctness.rationale: At level k the finite substitution prefix is U 0^n U with U=B0^mB, n=3m and B beginning and ending in one. All windows before j=5m are classified as padded suffixes and padded prefixes. The suffix family has distinct rightmost-one offsets, and the prefix family has distinct leftmost-one offsets. Cross-family repetitions before j are excluded by counts when i<m and by disjoint rightmost-one ranges when i>=m; the explicit F_m=F_{5m} proves sharpness. Standalone finite checks k=1..8 agree.

value.rationale: A fully explicit first-repeat threshold at every triadic substitution scale measures a mathematically motivated prefix-sensitive invariant introduced in the 2015 literature, for a natural non-uniformly recurrent automatic word. It provides a sharp collision witness and a 5/6 limiting ratio against the known total factor count, which itself does not determine first recurrence.
